definitions.xs: Extra-small effort-size label, ordered before s; no duration threshold is defined.
definitions.s: Small effort-size label, ordered between xs and m; no duration threshold is defined.
definitions.m: Medium effort-size label, ordered between s and l; no duration threshold is defined.
definitions.l: Large effort-size label, ordered between m and xl; no duration threshold is defined.
definitions.xl: Extra-large effort-size label, ordered after l; no duration threshold is defined.

standard.none: Project-defined effort labels; no external standard is adopted.
